notes: *sore* is taken as the rendering of the cognate adverbial accusative כַּעַס (rule 33), leaving גַּם unrepresented; the competing reading gives *sore* to גַּם and is named in the unit note.

בַּעֲבוּר fuses as preposition plus construct noun into the single *to*, headed on the construct (rules 23, 30); בְּעַד is unrepresented, the recasting *shut up her womb* leaving it nothing (rule 40).
